why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Request an early-access code Add yourself to the early access list on the Bread page . Codes go only to people on that list, and places open in waves.
2 Step 2 : Install the Bread wallet Bread installs on iOS, on Android or in Chrome as an extension. The Miden support page covers help with the app and feedback.
3 Step 3 : Set up your partner mainnet account Enter your code in the app and finish the fresh wallet setup. The account is pre-funded with a small amount of USDCx for network fees.
5 Step 5 : Read how Bread handles privacy The How Bread Works article explains what happens in the background. The testnet v0.16 post covers the v0.16 testnet, including its faucet.
